verdicts.quote: “This method allows your 3LO app to access Atlassian APIs on a user's behalf.”
verdicts.reason: Atlassian’s docs explicitly describe OAuth 2.0 (3LO) as the token-based method for apps acting on a user’s behalf; this is the most appropriate primary auth for a multi-tenant agent. ([developer.atlassian.com](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/security-overview/))

verdicts.quote: “When you create an OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app, it's private by default… If you want to distribute your app to other users, you must enable sharing.”
verdicts.reason: Credentials and distribution are managed self‑serve in the Developer Console; private sharing does not require a Marketplace listing or review. Atlassian also offers free developer cloud sites (“Cloud Developer Bundle… free forever”), supporting the “free” part. ([developer.atlassian.com](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/oauth/getting-started/managing-oauth-apps/)) ([atlassian.com](https://www.atlassian.com/licensing/cloud))

verdicts.quote: “The REST API allows you to access and update Jira entities, such as projects and issues.”
verdicts.reason: The official REST references span many core entities (issues, projects, workflows, users, etc.) plus separate Jira Software agile resources, meeting the “broad” definition. ([developer.atlassian.com](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/index/))

verdicts.quote: “The Atlassian Rovo MCP Server connects your AI agent to your Atlassian apps and work…”
verdicts.reason: This is an Atlassian-published MCP server and setup guide, confirming an official MCP offering from the vendor. ([developer.atlassian.com](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/rovo-mcp/guides/getting-started/))

verdicts.quote: “You can securely manage all your OAuth 2.0 (3LO)… apps in one place using the Atlassian developer console.”
verdicts.reason: Public docs, self‑serve OAuth, and extensive REST references mean Composio could ship now without special gating; private distribution via “enable sharing” further supports readiness. ([developer.atlassian.com](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/oauth/getting-started/managing-oauth-apps/))
